senses.gloss: f. (denom. of סוֹלֶת) [fish fried with flour,] a small fish believed to grow scales on reaching a certain age (cmp. אַפְיָין).
units: Ḥull. 66ᵃ; Ab. Zar. 39ᵃ אין לו … כגון הס׳ וכ׳ one that has no scales now but will grow them after a time, as, for instance, the sultanith &c.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 39a:3">Ib.</cite>, expl. <cite ref="H00787"><he>חֵילֶק</he> I</cite>. (Ar. <cite ref="O01045"><he>סֻלְתָּ׳</he></cite>).
